correctness.rationale: The exchangeable r-face Dirichlet mixture gives E B_i=1/m, E B_i^2=2/[m(r+1)], E B_i B_j=(r-1)/[m(m-1)(r+1)]. Explicit inversion of its two-eigenvalue Gram matrix gives K=1+delta^{-1}(sum_i lambda_i(x)lambda_i(y)-1/m). Convexity and strict sign conflict localize norm to vertices for r>=2; the beta-tail identity integrates the positive vertex kernel exactly and gives Lambda=2I-1 and sharp positivity defect. Differentiation of I in u proves universal strict m monotonicity and optimal ceiling r; separate limits prove proportional-r asymptotic. The standalone exact rational verifier passed 135 parameter pairs, but finite tests are supplementary.

originality.rationale: After searches of the published-results index, accessible prior claims and relevant full/partial primary texts, the closest known volume-only simplex formula covers exactly r=m but not the intermediate skeleton operators. Global FE and kernel-network bounds neither calculate nor imply sharp constants for face-balanced singular simplex observations. The new simultaneous all-(m,r) formula, fixed-rank ceiling and proportional-rank limit are not found in inspected material. Unknown differently named skeletal quadrature sources remain a documented priority risk.
residual_risks: Unindexed skeletal quadrature, simplex mass-lumping or singular-measure least-squares articles could contain equivalent formula under different terminology.
Only selected sections, not every page, of some long primary articles were read.
One primary PDF did not permit visual page inspection; comparison relies on accessible textual material.
Independent external priority and mathematical review have not been performed.

value.rationale: Canonical equal-probability face-skeleton observations interpolate vertices, all intermediate faces and volume while retaining affine invariance. One formula resolves the exact stability and positivity defect for every face rank and every simplex dimension. The sharp face-rank (not ambient-dimension) ceiling and proportional-face-rank law identify distinct structural high-dimensional regimes; the classification of all norming locations supplies complete sharpness witnesses. This is more than an arbitrary parameter slice or textbook reparametrization.
